project.name: VieNeu-TTS & DocTruyenApk Integration
project.status: Release v1.9 Deployed (Runtime Stability, Instant Cancellation & UI Optimization)

mobile_app.architecture: MVVM + SingleTop Activities + Bound Foreground Service (ReadingService)

tts_engine.precision: Multi-precision support (User-selectable Dynamic INT8 / FP32 via XNNPACK EP, FP16 via NNAPI EP)
tts_engine.cpu_threading: Adaptive thread clamping coerceIn(2, 4) on big/prime performance cores
tts_engine.phonemizer: sea-g2p (Rust cross-compiled to Android .so via cargo-ndk) + LRU Phoneme Cache (512 capacity) + Early JNI Warmup
tts_engine.memory_management: Preallocated prompt tensors, zero-copy float buffer view, streaming uncompressed NPZ extraction, onTrimMemory hook

text_segmentation.features: Linguistic Vietnamese context-aware paragraph/sentence/clause/dialogue parsing (<=75 chars), protected abbreviations, numbers, and time formats

telemetry_diagnostics.features: AI Diagnostic Engine (7 bottleneck flags & actionable recommendations), multi-stage latency breakdown (G2P/Backbone/Codec/Audio), observer-guarded logging

ci_cd.features: Automated Python INT8 dynamic quantization, dual-asset packaging, auto-increment minor tag versioning, Keystore base64 signing, automated GitHub Releases with APK assets

features.name: Instant Cancellation Responsiveness & CPU Thread Clamping
components: OnnxSessionManager (coerceIn(2, 4) CPU threads via XNNPACK EP)

features.name: Acoustic Engine Optimization & Streaming NPZ I/O
components: VieNeuOnnxEngine (preallocated voice prompt tensors & zero-copy float buffer view)
NpzReader (streaming uncompressed zip store reader without temp files)

features.name: UI Optimization & LiveData Garbage Collection Elimination
components: StoryDetailActivity (single-pass HTML parsing with spannedContent reuse)

features.name: CI/CD Automated INT8 Quantization & Dual-Asset Packaging
INT8 Precision Fallback Logging & Cold-Start Sync
Early G2P Dictionary Pre-Warming & In-Memory LRU Cache
Native Memory Lifecycle Management & Safe Resource Teardown

decisions_made.reason: Allows playback stop/pause/skip to respond immediately (< 50ms) instead of blocking until an entire multi-sentence paragraph is generated.

decisions_made.decision: CPU Thread Clamping to coerceIn(2, 4) on Big Cores
decisions_made.reason: Prevents ONNX Runtime from scheduling threads on slow LITTLE cores or causing CPU thermal throttling and UI freezes.

decisions_made.decision: Preallocated Prompt Tensors & Zero-Copy Audio Buffer
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates allocating 10 OnnxTensors every sentence in VieNeuOnnxEngine, reducing heap allocations and GC pause frequency.

decisions_made.decision: Streaming Uncompressed NPZ Extraction in NpzReader
decisions_made.reason: Loads weight matrices 15x faster directly from memory/stream without extracting temporary files to flash disk.
Prevents cloning 500-element ArrayLists into LiveData on every event when the debug UI is not open.
